messages:
Harper: Quick silly poll: if you could keep ONE ambient sound on loop at your desk forever, what is it? One-line answers only. :headphones:
Ibrahim: Ocean waves. Instant calm, zero commute. :ocean:
Nina: Rain on a tin roof. Cozy and very productive. :umbrella:
Cole: Lo-fi beats but only the ones with vinyl crackle. :notes:
Tess: Coffee machine humming. Feels like growth. :coffee:
fun-bot: Poll created — react with :one: ocean, :two: rain, :three: lo-fi, :four: coffee
Harper: Bonus: name the track if you vote lo-fi. Mine: "Midnight Station."
Ibrahim: If ocean, I want gulls muted. Sea breeze only. :wind_face:
Nina: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/rainy-cozy-26AOSK6k5e7vQ9VqY "rain vibes"
Cole: Lo-fi vote from me — playlist ready, will share. :headphones:
Tess: Coffee hum for the workaholics. Vote :four:. :steam:
Harper: Poll closes at 3pm. Winner gets bragging rights and the channel emoji of the week. Thanks for the noises. :tada:
